review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this pending-decision case. It preserves REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003 and DEC-001, matches the repository identity and base commit, and correctly requires repository, requirements and decisions evidence before blocking on the material unresolved DEC-001. The recommended raw-rejection acceptance scenarios remain conditional and do not authorize selecting OPT-1 or treating hypothetical input as a human Decision. Empty assignment expectations are consistent with the explicit prohibition on generating assignable tasks in this case; TASK-IMPLEMENT and TASK-VERIFY apply only after resolution. The supplied source supports index.js and index.d.ts as implementation and public-contract inspection owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts as verification scope. The limitFunction forwarding and Pick-based declaration reuse do not introduce separately maintained owners or mandatory forwarding edits. Package configuration establishes the xo, AVA and tsd verification entry point and provides no declaration-generation evidence that would displace index.d.ts as an owner. The empty team catalog does not invalidate this expectation because the deterministic decision gate precedes independent-review and assignment prerequisites. Gold and preview carry matching release-input fingerprints for repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling and metric policy. The original specification's preparation-state fields do not override that supplied frozen release input. This approval concerns expectation coherence only, not execution readiness or human confirmation. I reviewed the supplied data without running candidates, executing code or independently recomputing Service-calculated digests.
